When you start each run, you'll always have the same set of basic cards to start with. This includes:
* 1x [[Basic Block]]
* 1x [[Basic Dodge]]
* 2x [[Basic Shot]] (3x on HARD difficulty or above).
** On the [[Jupiter]] ship, one of the Basic Shots will be replaced with a [[Basic Shift]] instead.
* If on HARDER difficulty or above: 1x [[Corrupted Core]]

Additionally, each character in your crew has 2 cards from their deck they bring along with them. These are as follows:
* [[Dizzy]]
** 1x [[Block Shot]]
** 1x [[Shield Surge]]
* [[Riggs]]
** 1x [[Draw Shot]]
** 1x [[Scramble]]
* [[Peri]]
** 1x [[Lunge]]
** 1x [[Multi Shot]]
* [[Isaac]]
** 1x [[Attack Drone]]
** 1x [[Parallel Shift]]
* [[Drake]]
** 1x [[EMP Slug]]
** 1x [[Heatsink]]
* [[Max]]
** 1x [[Admin Deploy]]
** 1x [[Reroll]]
